Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Duration of service contract may be extended further beyond the initial contract duration (subject to satisf actory performance and mutual consent) The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity if required by the buyer. Bidders are bound to accept the orders accordingly. A Letter of consent is to be uploaded mandatory from the seller in ATC that we have followed all the terms and conditions, otherwise bid will not be considered. The bidder should submit an undertaking that the bidder's firm has not been black listed / debarred / prohi bited by any State / Central Government Departments / Organizations. The undertaking should be on Sta mp paper worth of 100 INR. . 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Human Resource Service Deployment of Existing working / deployed resources: 27 number of Existing working / deployed resources of the procurement department having job satisfactory certificate, will be continued by the successful Service Provider under the new contract also – subject to their consent to the Terms and conditions of new contract concluded on the basis of this bid.
